text: The Pacific Catastrophe Risk Assessment and Financing Initiative (PCRAFI) is a multi-partner program aimed at enhancing the financial resilience of Pacific Island Countries, including Papua New Guinea, against natural disasters. It provides a comprehensive risk information-to-action pipeline, integrating hazard data, exposure databases, and probabilistic risk modeling to inform sovereign and sectoral decision-making. The initiative supports the development of financial tools such as catastrophe insurance and budget reserves to mitigate fiscal impacts of disasters.
